I'm not American, but every 9/11 takes me right back to that day. My cousin lived in Battery Park City at the time and nobody in the family could reach him all day. Because this was on top of the fact that we had a coworker who was supposed to fly home from New York that morning, too, so in the time before we knew where the planes had originated and she was unable to reach us, we were already working very, very hard (and failing) not to imagine the worst. So, I ended up having to go home because I just couldn't calm down thinking my cousin or my coworker might be dead. It took until the wee hours the following morning for us to track down my cousin. He had walked to Brooklyn in his pajamas. Yup, I get emotional every 9/11.
